# Daniela Petruzalek (danicat.dev)

> Daniela Petruzalek is a Developer Relations Engineer at Google focused on Agentic Coding, Agent Development, and Cloud Native Go.

This repository provides technical articles, hands-on tutorials, architecture guides, and conference presentations on building software with autonomous AI agents, developing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and modern Go engineering.

## Agentic Coding

- [Google Jules: Hands-on with the Autonomous Coding Agent](https://danicat.dev/posts/jules-autonomous-coding-agent/): First look at Google Jules, the asynchronous autonomous coding agent. Explore GitHub issue resolution, automated PR generation, and developer workflows.
- [Can Anyone Vibe Code? The Future of Software Engineering](https://danicat.dev/posts/can-anyone-vibe-code/): Can anyone vibe code? An essay on why AI lowers the barrier to entry while making core software engineering discipline and orchestration more valuable.
- [How I Used Jules to Add a Featured Post to This Blog](https://danicat.dev/posts/jules-featured-post/): Case study on using Jules AI coding agent to implement a featured post section in Hugo and Tailwind CSS. Covers prompt iteration, styling, and learnings.
- [A Modern Developer Workflow for the AI-Enabled World](https://danicat.dev/posts/developer-workflow-ai-world/): A 2-dimensional prioritisation framework for modern AI developer workflows. Balance technical certainty and business value across Gemini CLI and Jules agents.
- [Customising Gemini CLI: GEMINI.md and System Prompts](https://danicat.dev/posts/gemini-cli-system-prompt/): Step-by-step guide to controlling Gemini CLI proactivity using GEMINI.md context files and GEMINI_SYSTEM_MD environment variable overrides.
- [Introducing Speedgrapher: An MCP Server for Vibe Writing](https://danicat.dev/posts/introducing-speedgrapher/): Learn how Speedgrapher uses Model Context Protocol prompts and tools to automate technical writing, Gunning Fog readability scoring, and editorial review.
- [Taming Vibe Coding: The Engineer's Practical Guide](https://danicat.dev/posts/taming-vibe-coding/): Apply software engineering rigor to vibe coding. Learn structured prompt templates, context engineering, 2x2 tool selection, and adapted TDD workflows.
- [Improving Coding Agents with Help from Science](https://danicat.dev/posts/improving-agentic-coding-with-science/): Discover how to evaluate AI coding agents using statistical rigor and A/B testing with Tenkai, Welch's t-test, Fisher's Exact Test, and Spearman correlation in Go.
- [Mastering Custom Agent Skills in Gemini CLI](https://danicat.dev/posts/agent-skills-gemini-cli/): Learn how to build and configure Agent Skills in Gemini CLI. Covers progressive disclosure, on-demand prompt loading, and deterministic Python analysis scripts.
- [Building Agent Skills with skill-creator](https://danicat.dev/posts/gemini-cli-skills-part-2/): Explore practical Agent Skills design with Gemini CLI's skill-creator. Detailed examples include latest-version, pyhd with Ruff, find-examples, and de-sloppify.
- [How to Do Code Reviews in the Agentic Era](https://danicat.dev/posts/code-reviews-in-2026/): Practical guide to reviewing AI-generated code and pull requests. Explains what architectural areas to scrutinize and what mechanical tasks to delegate to linters.
- [Build a Match 3 Arcade Game Using Gemini CLI](https://danicat.dev/posts/match3-game-gemini-cli/): Step-by-step tutorial on building a 2D Match-3 game in Go and Ebitengine using Gemini CLI. Covers plan mode, subagents for visual testing, and Cloud Run.
- [From Agile to Agentic: Scaling Enterprise AI Workflows](https://danicat.dev/posts/from-agile-to-agentic/): How to translate Agile practices into agentic workflows. Covers prompt-based story writing, conversational architecture with MCP, and non-coding agents.
- [The Hitchhiker's Guide to Antigravity 2.0](https://danicat.dev/posts/the-hitchhikers-guide-to-antigravity-2-0/): Comprehensive guide to Google Antigravity 2.0 from Google I/O 2026. Covers the Agent Manager desktop app, the Go-based agy CLI, and the Python SDK.
- [Mastering Hooks in Coding Agents: A Practical Guide](https://danicat.dev/posts/mastering-hooks-in-coding-agents/): Deep dive into hooks for coding agents like Google Antigravity. Learn to intercept PreToolUse and PostToolUse events to enforce linting and DLP guardrails.
- [State of Agentic Coding in 2026: Skills, Hooks, Subagents](https://danicat.dev/posts/state-of-agentic-coding/): Retrospective on agentic coding in 2026. Compares planning systems, Agent Skills vs MCP, subagent orchestration, and deterministic hooks in production.
- [The Rise of the Subagents: Orchestrating Swarm Coding in Antigravity](https://danicat.dev/posts/the-rise-of-the-subagents/): Explore the evolution of subagents in Antigravity and learn how to orchestrate autonomous coding swarms in Go using the Swarm Coding skill.
- [Gemini for Go Developers - Part 2: Coding with Gemini](https://danicat.dev/posts/gemini-for-go-developers-part-2-coding-with-gemini/): Part 2 of Gemini for Go: maximize Go's agentic affinity, explore Antigravity surfaces, configure MCP servers, and build an AI-native Go toolkit.
- [The Pragmatic Guide to Agent Skills](https://danicat.dev/posts/the-pragmatic-guide-to-agent-skills/): A practical guide to creating custom Agent Skills for coding agents. Explore real-world use cases across documentation, workflows, and agent traits.
- [Presentation: Vibe Code a 2D Game using Go and Gemini](https://speakerdeck.com/danicat/vibe-code-a-2d-game-using-go-and-gemini): Workshop supporting material exploring 2D game development with Go, Ebitengine, and Gemini CLI.
- [Presentation: AI-driven development](https://danicat.dev/events/): Exploring modern AI-driven development workflows, developer tooling, and autonomous agent pair programming.
- [Presentation: Hands-On Agentic Coding: Build and Deploy an Arcade Game](https://danicat.dev/events/): Hands-on workshop exploring agentic coding workflows by designing, building, and deploying a playable retro arcade game with AI agents.
- [Presentation: Build a cloud-native game with Natural Language](https://danicat.dev/events/): Live build demonstrating how natural language prompt engineering and AI coding agents can construct and deploy a full cloud-native game.
- [Presentation: A Gopher's Guide to Vibe Coding](https://speakerdeck.com/danicat/a-gophers-guide-to-vibe-coding-b7ee3039-5fc6-45a0-8e94-ef4ade3f1e73): Keynote on bringing vibe coding to the Go community, balancing prompt speed with classical software engineering rigor.

## Agent Development

- [Turning My Computer into USS Enterprise with AI Agents](https://danicat.dev/posts/diagnostic-agent-uss-enterprise/): Build a Star Trek-inspired system diagnostic assistant in Python using Gemini, Vertex AI Agent Engine, and osquery function calling for natural language telemetry.
- [Digging Deeper into the Vertex AI SDK for Python](https://danicat.dev/posts/vertex-ai-sdk-python/): Deep dive into client-API communication in the Vertex AI SDK for Python. Learn to structure system instructions, function declarations, and chat sessions.
- [System Instructions & Agent Tools: Practical Python Guide](https://danicat.dev/posts/system-instructions-agent-tools/): Learn to combine system instructions, multi-turn chat history, and osquery tools in Python with Vertex AI to build an autonomous diagnostic agent.
- [Building GoDoctor: An MCP Server with Gemini CLI and Go](https://danicat.dev/posts/how-to-build-an-mcp-server-with-gemini-cli-and-go/): Step-by-step tutorial on building GoDoctor, an MCP server in Go with Gemini CLI. Covers stdio and HTTP transports, 3-step handshakes, and Cloud Run deployment.
- [Hello, MCP World: Model Context Protocol Architecture with Go](https://danicat.dev/posts/hello-mcp-world/): Introduction to Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture in Go based on GopherCon UK 2025. Covers Hosts, Clients, Servers, Tools, Prompts, and Resources.
- [How to Create a Diagnostic Agent with Agent Development Kit](https://danicat.dev/posts/diagnostic-agent-with-adk/): Build an autonomous system diagnostic agent in Python using Google ADK, osquery, and Vertex AI RAG for automated schema discovery and multi-level health checks.
- [Beyond Dev-UI: Building a Custom Interface for ADK Agents](https://danicat.dev/posts/building-aida/): Learn how to replace the Google ADK Dev-UI with a custom FastAPI backend, vanilla JS client, and real-time animated streaming avatar using Gemini CLI.
- [How to Build an Offline Agent with ADK, Ollama and SQLite](https://danicat.dev/posts/building-aida-part-2/): Step-by-step guide to building a 100% offline AI agent using Google ADK, local Qwen 2.5 via Ollama and LiteLLM, and local SQLite vector RAG with sqlite-rag.
- [Gemini for Go Developers: Building Agents in Go](https://danicat.dev/posts/gemini-for-go-developers-part-3-building-agents/): Part 3 of Gemini for Go Developers: build a Retro Game Appraiser agent using the Go GenAI SDK, Genkit, and Google ADK before deploying to Cloud Run.
- [Presentation: Building Rich Agent UIs: From Text to Web Components with ADK & A2UI](https://danicat.dev/events/): Hands-on workshop demonstrating how to transform standard text-based LLM chatbots into interactive, rich web applications using the Agent Development Kit (ADK) and A2UI.
- [Presentation: Building Agentic Interfaces with A2UI](https://danicat.dev/events/): Deep dive into building rich, dynamic user interfaces for autonomous agents using A2UI and the Agent Development Kit (ADK).
- [Presentation: Build Rich Agentic Interfaces with ADK and A2UI](https://danicat.dev/events/): Hands-on session demonstrating how to design and build interactive, multimodal agentic user interfaces with Google's ADK and A2UI framework.
- [Presentation: Build your own executive assistant with ADK and Gemini](https://speakerdeck.com/danicat/devfest-pisa-2026-build-your-own-executive-assistant-with-adk-and-gemini): Explore how to leverage ADK and Gemini to create a personalized executive assistant.
- [Presentation: Advanced Techniques for Building Agents with ADK and Vertex AI](https://danicat.dev/events/): Advanced agent architectures with Agent Development Kit (ADK) and Vertex AI.
- [Presentation: Making of GoDoctor: an MCP server for Go development](https://speakerdeck.com/danicat/making-of-godoctor-lessons-learned-while-building-a-go-aware-mcp-server): Deep dive into the design and implementation of GoDoctor, a specialized Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Go.
- [Presentation: Tech Talk: Diagnostic agent using Gemini and OSQuery](https://speakerdeck.com/danicat/diagnostics-agent-with-adk-gemini-and-osquery): Build a natural language system diagnostic agent that inspects operating system state via osquery function calling.
- [Presentation: How to Build an MCP Server with Go and Gemini CLI](https://danicat.dev/events/): Hands-on workshop on building and deploying a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to extend the Gemini CLI with custom Go tools.
- [Presentation: The Gopher's Craft in the Age of AI](https://speakerdeck.com/danicat/golab-2025-the-gophers-craft-in-the-age-of-ai): The evolving craft of Go developers in the age of AI, extending models with custom tools and protocols.

## Applied GenAI

- [From Prompt to Infrastructure with Gemini Cloud Assist](https://danicat.dev/posts/gemini-cloud-assist/): Design Google Cloud infrastructure using natural language with Gemini Cloud Assist and Application Design Center. Generate and export Terraform modules.
- [Bringing Old Photos to Life with Genkit and Gemini 3](https://danicat.dev/posts/genkit-go-photo-restoration/): Tutorial on building a 4K photo restoration tool in Go using Genkit and Gemini 3 Pro Image (Nano Banana Pro). Covers Handlebars dotprompt schemas and flows.
- [Gemini for Go Developers - Part 1: The Gemini Model Family](https://danicat.dev/posts/gemini-for-go-developers-part-1-model-family/): Part 1 of Gemini for Go Developers: compare Gemini 3.x, Flash, Pro, and Nano Banana models, explore APIs, and write your first Go code with GenAI SDK.
- [Presentation: Build a photo restoration app using Genkit Go and Nano Banana Pro](https://danicat.dev/events/): Workshop building GlowUp, an AI photo restoration tool using Genkit Go and Gemini 3 Pro Image (Nano Banana Pro).
- [Presentation: Top 5 Codelabs From NEXT](https://danicat.dev/events/): Walkthrough and practical demonstration of the top 5 developer codelabs from Google Cloud NEXT.
- [Presentation: Go for GenAI!](https://speakerdeck.com/danicat/go-for-genai): Keynote presentation exploring the intersection of Go and Generative AI.
- [Presentation: Gemini 2.x for Developers](https://danicat.dev/events/): Hands-on workshop on building applications with Gemini models, tool use, and multimodal APIs.

## Perspectives

- [Hello World: A New Space for Technical Narratives](https://danicat.dev/posts/hello-world/): Welcome to danicat.dev: exploring technical narratives in software engineering, Google Cloud, AI agents, and career reflections by Daniela Petruzalek.
- [A Model for Perceived Time: Why Years Pass Faster as We Age](https://danicat.dev/posts/a-model-for-perceived-time/): Mathematical modeling of perceived time acceleration using 1/age calculus and Python simulations. Explains why the perceptual midpoint of life is age 9.
- [Reflecting on Six Months at Google: DevRel, AI, and Milestones](https://danicat.dev/posts/six-months-at-google/): Retrospective on my first six months as a Google DevRel Engineer. Covers 15 global events, AI ecosystem reskilling (MCP, Agents), and personal milestones.
- [My 2025 Year in Review: Joining Google and Taming Vibe Coding](https://danicat.dev/posts/my-2025-year-in-review/): Retrospective on 2025: joining Google DevRel, embracing disciplined vibe coding, releasing GoDoctor and Speedgrapher MCP servers, and key lessons for 2026.
- [Generative AI and Art: Is It Really Just Slop?](https://danicat.dev/posts/genai-and-art-is-it-really-just-slop/): An essay exploring whether generative AI art is truly low-effort slop, examining gatekeeping, historical parallels, prompt craft, and creative intent.
- [Presentation: GenAI and Art: Is it really just slop?](https://speakerdeck.com/danicat/genai-and-art-is-it-really-just-slop): Keynote exploring generative AI and art, analyzing historical resistance, prompt craft, and creative intent.

## Software Engineering

- [Presentation: Production Ready 'Hello, World!'](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1zkAvvb1jP2qhlOor4ka_W2EEv-f7rX_kgIWr-v1maC4/pub?start=false&loop=false&delayms=3000): Going beyond basics to implement a production-grade API with logging, error handling, configuration, and testing.
- [Presentation: Who test the tests?](https://github.com/gophercon/2024-talks/tree/main/DanielaPetruzalek-WhoTestsTheTests): Exploration of mutation testing in Go. Programmatically rewrite code to ensure tests catch real regressions.

## Codelabs & Workshops

- [Create Your Own Executive Assistant with Agent Development Kit](https://codelabs.developers.google.com/cloud-adk-executive-assistant#0): Build a personalized AI executive assistant using the Agent Development Kit (ADK) and Gemini.
- [Build Rich Agentic Interfaces with ADK and A2UI](https://codelabs.developers.google.com/adk-gemini-a2ui#0): Enhance autonomous agents with A2UI to build dynamic user interfaces beyond simple text and markdown.
- [Build a Match 3 Arcade Game With Gemini and Antigravity](https://codelabs.developers.google.com/cloud-crush-agy#0): Build Cloud Crush, a 2D Match-3 arcade game in Go using Gemini 3 and the Antigravity CLI agent.
- [Build an MCP Server with Go and Gemini CLI](https://codelabs.developers.google.com/cloud-gemini-cli-mcp-go#0): Official Google codelab on extending the Gemini CLI with custom tools using Go and the Model Context Protocol.
- [Build GlowUp: AI Photo Restoration](https://codelabs.developers.google.com/cloud-genkit-go-nano-banana#0): Tutorial and codelab using Genkit Go and Gemini Nano Banana Pro for 4K image restoration.
